risk_note: RV2 money (union taobao adapter + orders pipeline + content config registry). D10-1250 ① (B1-18 leftover): BR-CALC-18 — Taobao's order payload itemizes subsidy income (official pub_share_pre_fee_for_sdy / pub_share_fee_for_sdy), so the adapter now outputs subsidy_commission_fen (tk_status 3 takes the settle field, else the pre field; BR-CALC-26 yuan→fen; missing / null / '--' / empty / invalid → null, not 0; no service-fee deduction on the subsidy, whether one applies is unverified; est / settle unchanged — subsidy never enters N). JD and PDD cannot itemize → not output. The orders pipeline writes orders.subsidy_commission_fen and feeds it to the commission snapshot on first insert, on update, and on the compensating retry (latest payload value, not the stale row; platforms that never output the field keep the stored value per frozen source-backfill/rerun). BR-CALC-25 — config union.<platform>.subsidy_itemized (boolean, config.business, unset = true per 08 C-27); only JSON false → first insert sets orders.credit_requires_settle = true (no hold, N unchanged, snapshot as usual); which platform is false waits for the 09 verdict, no value changed here; credit.enabled untouched. The settlement guard needs no change (R5 batch items come from settlement rows; orchestrator 14:14 confirmed against 06 C-27 (e)). Production reads the switch through an orders worker-runtime port wired in app.module.ts via createContentReader; an unwired pipeline (direct construction, frozen rule tests) falls back to reading config_items on its own transaction (commented). Ledger patch #3158 added specs/union/taobao.md, pdd.md (frozen [AC-B1-18a#2] now needs the subsidy row), two content unit tests (item count 145 → 148), worker-runtime and app.module.ts. Host: tsc -b apps/api 0; unit 141 files 1487; spec/orders int 220 files 1899; rule tests 55 green. D10-1253: the first push of #3163 was red in CI because the three new config keys broke six frozen full-order config lists under test/spec/content; prerequisite test-change B1-18ct (#3168, merged; fresh Claude appended the keys only, read-only reviews Claude pass and Codex money pass) registered the keys and appended them, so this rebase drops config-registry.ts and the two content unit tests from B1-18c (already on main); the rest of the implementation diff is unchanged, so the money round-1 verdict stands (no incremental round, per D10-1253). After the rebase: tsc -b apps/api 0; test/spec content + subsidy-split + spec-docs unit 95 files 4096; content + subsidy-itemized int 90 files 1599. D10-1255 / D10-1256: one-line `return true;` added to the mapping property callback as its own test(spec) commit; registry.test.ts moved to main by prerequisite B1-18cu (#3174), so it is no longer in this diff; the implementation diff is unchanged (money round-1 verdict stands).

reviews.note: Codex money review (effort medium) round 1 pass, no findings, on implementation 69bd52a56843: rounding / sign of the subsidy, null vs 0, update and retry paths use the latest subsidy, idempotent re-delivery, credit_requires_settle only ever set true, subsidy_itemized semantics (only JSON false), N unchanged when false, the unwired config_items fallback.

spec_test_review.note: Codex spec-test (effort medium): round 1 fail with five S1 (property callback wrapped in an outer not.toThrow; update path uncovered; N could be zeroed when subsidy_itemized=false; hold not pinned; re-delivery idempotency) → test attempt 2 (fresh independent Claude) added [AC-B1-18c#12]–#15 and moved the property assertions inside the callback, red/2 PASS 54; round 2 fail with two S1: (1) 'the property callback does not return true' — not adopted per D10-1251 ③: fast-check treats an undefined return as success and the expect inside the callback throws on a wrong amount, which the reviewer itself acknowledged; (2) the compensating-retry branch could pass the stale null subsidy to the snapshot — accepted. D10-1251 (orchestrator 15:11): test attempt 3 (3 of 3, fresh independent Claude) added only [AC-B1-18c#16] (retry branch, order and commission_splits subsidy both 200), nothing else changed, red/3 PASS 55; round 3 per D10-1251 ② reviewed only that increment (--base the round-2 commit, no bump): the retry S1 is closed; its only S1 restated round-2 (1), already ruled not adopted by D10-1251 ③, so it is recorded here and not treated as a new S1 (reported to the orchestrator). D10-1255 / D10-1256 (orchestrator): the round-2 / round-3 point 'the property callback does not return true' was re-raised three times; D10-1255 withdrew the D10-1251 ③ non-adoption and had a fresh independent Claude add only `return true;` at the end of that callback in test/spec/union/subsidy-split/mapping.test.ts (one-line diff, assertions / titles / order unchanged; a separate test(spec) commit before the implementation; not counted as a test attempt). The red_exempt route of D10-1254 was withdrawn (red-check does not honour exemptions for a new file); per D10-1256 the prerequisite test-change B1-18cu (#3174, merged) put test/spec/orders/subsidy-itemized/registry.test.ts on main byte-for-byte (blob fff7289ac95c, same as the round-3 commit; green on main, a mutation skipping one key's registration turns it red), so this task no longer carries that file and the red check judges only mapping / pipeline: red PASS, 52 rule tests in 2 files. A read-only Codex spec-test gate record (not counted) then passed with no findings: the return-true finding is closed and nothing new was raised.
